findings.evidence: Lines 70 and 84 expose the `Paths.lift` body globally; lines 95–144 currently characterize the object using definitional identification with `Quiver.Path i j →₀ k`, while lines 213–220 already provide eliminators for the equivalence.
findings.fix: Remove the section-wide `@[expose]`. Keep `indecProjRep` opaque and expose an abstract path basis (or pointwise linear equivalence) plus action lemmas stated through that basis, instead of requiring raw `Finsupp` terms to typecheck by unfolding.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes every definition in the module, including `indecProjRepHomEquiv`, despite its apply/symm API; downstream proofs can depend on implementation details.

findings.evidence: Each lemma reduces a constructed morphism or represented postcomposition to its canonical normal form; neighboring `indecProjRepHom_app_single` and the two equivalence apply lemmas are already `@[simp]`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to these non-looping characteristic reductions so the universal property works through its API without manual rewrites.
findings.issue: The constructor/eliminator and naturality normal forms are not tagged for simplification: `indecProjRepHom_app_nil`, `indecProjRepHom_app_nil_self`, and `indecProjRepHomEquiv_comp` (lines 184, 190, 224).

summary: The public API exposes implementation bodies wholesale and omits simp annotations on core universal-property reductions.
